statement: Let rho be a 4x4 PPT state invariant under all U tensor conjugate(U), with correlated Hermitian block A on |ii> and offdiagonal-basis diagonal entries p_ij. Suppose A can be made entrywise real nonnegative by one local diagonal phase gauge, and p_ij=p_ji for all i!=j. Then rho is separable, hence cannot be a PPT/SN3 target. More generally, if all p_ij>0 and positive weights r_i exist with p_ij/p_ji=r_j/r_i, the same conclusion holds by an invertible Alice diagonal filter. This is a known-matrix-cone consequence, not a claim of new separability theory.
proof: PPT implies A>=0 and each block [[p_ij,A_ij],[conjugate(A_ij),p_ji]]>=0, hence under symmetric p, p_ij>=|A_ij|. After the phase gauge, A is a real entrywise nonnegative PSD 4x4 matrix. The known DNN_4=CP_4 theorem gives A=sum_l w_l w_l^T for entrywise nonnegative real w_l. Let v_l have entries sqrt((w_l)_i). The diagonal-phase twirl of the product projector [v_l tensor v_l] has correlated block w_l w_l^T and offdiagonal diagonal entries (w_l)_i(w_l)_j. Summing these twirls gives exactly A and offdiagonal entries A_ij; the remaining (p_ij-A_ij)[|ij>] terms are nonnegative product projectors. Therefore rho is separable. For the detailed-balance extension, choose Alice filter F=diag(sqrt(r_i)); then p'_ij=r_i p_ij=p'_ji, A'_ij=sqrt(r_i*r_j) A_ij, and PPT, phase gaugeability, and separability equivalence are preserved by invertibility.
source_and_scope: The DNN_4=CP_4 import is summarized in Gulati-Nechita-Park arXiv:2509.15201v4 section 2.2, https://arxiv.org/html/2509.15201v4, citing Berman-Shaked-Monderer Theorem 2.4. The PCP/separability connection is developed in Johnston-MacLean arXiv:1807.06897v1 https://arxiv.org/html/1807.06897v1; the twirl proof above is explicit. A phase-covariant PPT/SN3 search with symmetric or strictly positive detailed-balance p must therefore have frustrated phases in its state correlated block, not merely in a witness. Asymmetrically directed p outside detailed balance and phase-frustrated A remain open.
